messages:
rachel: Quick thread: low-overhead approach for encrypted sharded safetensors so KMS doesn't become our bottleneck on scale-ups. Idea: bake a single encrypted DEK per model, store as sidecar.wrap, derive per-slice keys via HKDF locally. Pre-decrypt a tiny hotset of slices only.
devon: how do you pick the hotset? naive prefix vs profile-based?
rachel: default prefix N=3 for chat models, but we also support profile-hotset (evaller-produced bitmap) for large models. manifest.hotset_bitmap optional.
owen: unwrap cost still exists. One unwrap per host per TTL; that seems fine. But bursts during autoscale could still hit KMS.
priya: cluster cache of wrap ciphertext + staggered prewarm solves spikes. infra-bot: created INF-1800 to add cluster wrap cache and prewarm cron.
devon: what about slice atomicity? loader should tag slices with manifest ETag. If ETag changes mid-decrypt, abort and restart.
rachel: yes. Also include AEAD tag per slice; verify before publishing slice-ready. On failure, fallback to service-side decrypt or cold path.
owen: metrics: wrap_unwrap_latency, slice_decrypt_cpu_ms, hotset_bytes_predecrypted, slice_tag_failures.
priya: ops play: if slice_decrypt_cpu > threshold, pause pre-decrypt and queue on-demand. Add circuit breaker to protect host.
rachel: I'll write RFC follow-up with manifest examples: {slice_size, wrap_ciphertext, wrap_kid, hotset_bitmap, slice_checksums}. Will post in docs and link INF-1800. Thanks :thumbsup:
